name: FunkyFarm
purpose: Check parcel outlines before filing, prepare corrections after filing, and explicitly review reused answers without repeated entry.
current_focus: Private LPIS parcel drawing and checks
Explicit review of every reused answer
Real SIGPAC parcel and PNOA aerial demo with a staged private claim mistake
Real record import and source-linked extraction review
Guided easy form with typed crop changes
Seven isolated sample farm scenarios with 39 editable records
Simple farmer steps and a permission-scoped adviser worklist
adviser_flow: Complete authorised work and keep confirmation
modules: Private adviser questions and public knowledge sharing
Connected assistants and optional in-app help
release_gate: Web hackathon demo. Native work is excluded by the current request. External gates below remain necessary before broader production claims.
automation: Field drawing, editing, splitting and merging proposals
Optional WebMCP and authenticated assistant tools

legal_checks.coverage: Selected source-backed EU record duties and explicitly identified national information, not a complete legal inventory
legal_checks.status: Needs information, needs adviser, or ready for review; never a universal compliance certificate
legal_checks.rules: Keep actual dates, original units and source versions. Unknown applicability and national deadlines stay unknown.

assistant_preference.first: Farmer-owned Claude or ChatGPT through a revocable, selected-farm OAuth MCP connection
assistant_preference.fallback: Explicitly selected local model on Hetzner, with bounded resources and opt-in farm context
assistant_preference.approval: Models may read permitted records and stage proposals; a human separately reviews consequential changes
assistant_preference.availability: Provider-account acceptance and language quality are separate from transport and model tests

invariants: A purchase is not a record of use.
An estimate is not a confirmed farm fact.
A copied previous-year fact is not a new observation.
A prepared form is not a submission or an acceptance.
App sharing permission is not a government mandate.
AI cannot grant itself approval or access.
Issued records retain their original reviewed sources.
A changed source identifies affected issued reports.
Every connection states its actual supported operations.
Farm data remains private across accounts and adviser grants.
external_gates: Actual Claude and ChatGPT account acceptance

deployment.requirement: Immutable release with app-specific isolation, health checks, backup and rollback

acceptance: Before and after-filing correction preparation with sourced date conditions
verification_policy: One integrated final workflow pass after source freeze; fix and rerun only affected failures. Never claim unavailable external evidence.
